pages.text: Rituals are performed using the Altar. To start a ritual, place ritual's catalyst into the Altar, then place the other required items in pedestals surrounding it.$(br)Each surrounding pedestal must be connected to the Altar via blood, otherwise it will not be able to access the pedestal's items$(br2)The ritual can then be initiated by crouching and interacting with the Altar.
pages.title: Performing Rituals

pages.text: Rituals can also be performed on others. To change the ritual's target, crouch and interact with the Altar while holding a blood-storing item that is tracking another being.$(br2)You will know this has worked when the small slot on the side of the Altar is filled.
pages.title: Targeting Others

pages.text: The Altar can be triggered via a redstone signal; although it will only begin a ritual if a target is set. When triggered this way, the target is not cleared post-ritual.$(br2)The Altar also outputs a comparator signal equivelant to the progress of the current active ritual.
pages.title: Redstone

pages.text: The target can be cleared without performing a ritual by crouching and interacting with an empty Altar
